profit_quality.assessment: 2025 reported parent net profit was HK$97.279m, but HK$14.963m PPE disposal gain, HK$1.078m FVTPL gain and HK$0.960m government grants are not treated as durable operating earnings. 2024 and 2025 operating cash flow both exceeded profit, yet 2025 cash flow benefited from receivable collection and the business has large government/quasi-government receivables and customer concentration. The main denominator uses HK$75m pre-haircut distributable cash profit and a 0.75 cash-profit haircut.
adjustments: Remove large 2025 PPE disposal gain from sustainable profit thinking.
Do not capitalize FVTPL life insurance fair value gain or government grants as recurring operating profit.
Use 2023-2025 parent profit history as a sanity check; five-year summary gives 2023 parent profit but not 2023 operating cash flow.
Reflect revenue decline, backlog decline and customer concentration in a 0.75 profit haircut.
Treat ordinary operating lease payments through cash flow/profit quality, not as a separate full cash-pool debt deduction.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2025 operating cash flow HK$198.696m and PPE purchase HK$47.114m; 2024 operating cash flow HK$262.441m and PPE purchase HK$34.982m. Cash conversion is strong in these two years, but affected by receivable reductions.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Stable positive cash generation supports a non-null denominator, but one-off gains, falling revenue/backlog, customer concentration and working-capital dependence require a material discount.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Reported OCF / parent net profit was about 2.04x in 2025 and 4.87x in 2024, but both periods include working-capital release.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Maintenance capex is not disclosed separately; HK$35m is used as a conservative normal maintenance capex reference against recent PPE purchases of HK$47.114m in 2025 and HK$34.982m in 2024.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: No extra normal reinvestment is deducted from the pre-haircut HK$75m because the selected denominator is already below 2025 adjusted profit and far below 2025/2024 FCF; residual working-capital risk is captured in the 0.75 haircut.
